title: Chapter 655
paragraphs: Chapter 655
Episode 166. Traces of the Coldran Tundra (2)
"Miss, please calm down."
"Hedo, didn't you hear what that crazy demon dragon just blurted out!?"
"I heard."
"Then how can you tell me to calm down? Jin is mine, I'll tear that...... Jin, were you a married man!?"
"What you're doing right now is something Jin Runcan would not like. And Jin Runcan is unmarried."
"That's right? That wretch was just talking nonsense, right? That demon dragon is really going to die by my hands one day."
Sandra wanted to make a bigger fuss, but she shut her mouth when she saw Jin's side profile. His expression looked very sad.
The faintly white sky of the tundra was quickly dyed black by Jephrin's magic. She was practically 'erasing' the knights who began to gather.
She didn't show her usual arrogance hidden behind laughter and dignity. She was keeping her promise with Jin.
"It's about time we should go, tower keeper. It seems we don't have much time."
Of course, not all knights had begun to fight Jephrin. About 20 percent were still near the cave, keeping watch of their surroundings.
"Hedo."
"Yes, Miss."
"Can you handle that many knights by yourself?"
"Why do you ask?"
"Can you, or can you not?"
"I can."
"Then, for Jin, Hedo, you should open the way by yourself."
Hedo was momentarily shocked that Sandra could think so deeply.
"Of course, I can do that, but the 12th generation might disagree."
"Why?"
"They're not the type to hand over their burdens. Anyway, you have given a very unique opinion."
Jin was already moving forward. His Bradamante was wrapped in a dark spirit.
There were about a hundred knights left near the cave.
The moment they confirmed Jin was approaching, thirteen of them were cut down. In the blink of an eye, his Spirit Sword First Form, Soul Slash, was unfolding continuously.
'As expected......they've all been completely consumed.'
The knights steeped in chaos had become grotesque monsters that could no longer be called 'Knights of Runcan'.
Their twisted arms grotesquely swung their swords, and their legs, which had become like thorny bushes, inflicted wounds on themselves with every step, spilling chaos instead of blood.
Their two eyeballs were hollowed out like caves, and from their mouths came only eerie breaths and screams.
Jin was swinging his sword, putting them to rest in an instant. That was the only thing he could do for them, who had devoted their loyalty to the family as knights.
'Roza... you will pay the price soon, surely.'
Hedo didn't even need to draw his sword.
To be precise, he was making a judgment that it would be better not to help while watching Jin's swordsmanship.
'There isn't a single wasted movement... just like Sir Shiron's sword.'
In terms of precision, there was not much difference compared to Shiron.
That's how Hedo was seeing Jin's sword.
For a moment, he forgot about his position and status and was captivated by Jin's figure, as if appreciating a magnificent piece of art.
"What's with that dumb expression? Don't tell me Hedo has also fallen for Jin?"
"I was just a little shocked, Miss. People who haven't seen Sir Shiron in person might think the 12th generation has entered Changsung."
"The incident in the Sota Desert where you almost got beaten was just a few years ago. Back then, Hedo overpowered Jin and his companions, but what about now?"
"What do you mean?"
"Can you win?"
"I don't think I can. I expected it since he wandered through the Sword Garden alone, but seeing it up close gives a different feeling."
Sandra burst into laughter as if it was something to be proud of.
"See! If it's Jin, there's definitely a chance. I didn't think so at first either, so it's not Hedo's fault. So, what about doing as I said last time... oh, that was a surprise!"
Hedo cut off a strand of magic that fell near Sandra. Jephrin was subtly scattering shockwaves towards Sandra while dealing with the knights engulfed in chaos.
"Ha, she's subtly mean. She's over a thousand years old and acting like a child."
While they were moving and conversing, Jin had already handled more than half of the knights left near the cave.
Right in front of the cave, those who were left seemed to be the top elders of the Black Knights or the Black Sword Association, or the top execution knights.
As Jin approached them, slashing through the knights, their spirits grew larger and larger.
'Were they hiding their strength?'
Fifteen in total.
Their transformed state took a different form from the knights that had come before. Not twisted and grotesque, but like a finely crafted doll, a stable appearance.
'It seems they have retained their sanity.'
The pupils were not black holes, but similar to ordinary humans. However, like Rosa, horns were present and chaos-blade-like enhancements reinforced various parts of their bodies.
"I am the 12th Genie Jin Runcandel. Identify yourself."
[Your qualification as a rider has been revoked, Rebel Jin.]
A man in the middle of the group stepped forward.
He had a slightly changed face, but it was completely unfamiliar. Jin assumed from him that the other party must have been a black knight.

"You used to wear a black helmet. Now Rosa has accepted the chaos, and it seems to have been quite reorganized, but until then it was a truly glorious helmet. Why are you standing there in that form?"
[Whether I wore a black helmet or not. The task of the family swords is only to fight for the family. The knights you are killing now have only changed for Runcandel.]
"I heard there are not many who became monsters voluntarily. I'm curious about your thoughts, Jordan."
[If Runcandel was a family that allowed such voluntary changes, would it have existed until now? Runcandel has always been about control, command, and power.]
"That means you guys are a group who sincerely agreed with Rosa's rebellion unlike them."

[You are just trying to realize your personal desire to become a head of family, rebel. That's why you've already allied with the remaining forces. Thanks to Lady Rosa, Runcandel has finally become the best in the world. But you know what? If you hadn't betrayed, Lady Rosa would have made you the head of the family.]
Huwook…
The aura that stained the Bradamante disappeared.

[What do you think would have happened to Runcandel, or even the Hufester Alliance, without Lady Rosa? It would have been crushed and disappeared by Zipple and Kinselo, whom you begged to form an alliance…]
"I will show no mercy to you. And, don't mess with me."
Instead of the aura, the blazing aura was wrapping around Bradamante.
At the same time, a flash of light went off, and the right arm of the black knight who was having a conversation with Jin fell off.
It was one acceleration short of the lightspeed stab that added a brainwave, but it was enough. After all, it was a sword with the name "secret weapon".
"Did you think I wouldn't know that you were trying to buy some time by dragging on with excuses until reinforcements arrive?"
The black knight's fallen arm was quickly regenerating.
Then he tried to prepare a response, but Jin had already pushed back the other knights and entered his rear.
"Did you think you'd avoided it? I initially aimed to cut off your arm."
The regenerating right arm was cut off again, and the retaliating left arm also rolled on the ground.
Then Jin grabbed his horn and slammed his head into the ground.
[Cough!]
"I said, I won't show mercy to you guys……"
While the black knight was trampled and struggling, the remaining knights drew their swords at Jin.
Jin effortlessly parried all of their swords in his place.
Shockwaves radiated in layers, sending the charging knights flying back. They were all trembling, coughing up black chaos like blood.
"Be grateful that I'm busy, as much as I want to painstakingly inflict pain on each and every one of you, I don't have the luxury to do so."
Although he said that, the knights who charged at Jin were feeling pain that permeated their bones. A pain on a completely different level from what other knights felt when being killed by Zephyrin.
By then, Hedodo had also joined in to start dealing with the remaining knights.
Hedodo deliberately didn't amplify their pain, but as his sword technique was naturally more destructive than Jin's, it just happened that way.
Five minutes.
That was all it took to deal with all fifteen knights, including the black knight, who were once at the top level.

While part of it was because the two of them were known as the strongest in the world, Jin was well aware that the 'class' of the knights who had fallen into chaos was declining, except for special cases like Stahl.
If the knights hadn't accepted the chaos, it would have taken more time. Rosa and the Prophet were choosing to increase the total power, even if it decreased the individual 'class'.
'Or maybe once they've accepted the chaos, there's no other way.'
Jin plunged his sword into the back of the trampled black knight.
[Inside... there is no one you're looking for. You won't find them.]
"Is that all you have to say as your last words? We all know that Hister isn't in the Garden of Swords."
At those words, the black knight grinned.
[Yes, you're right. The red-haired woman is already dead... Hahaha.]
"What did you say?"
When Jin reacted, the black knight laughed as if it was funny.
For a few seconds, Jin stopped moving and looked down at him.
He was flinching, pulling something out of his pocket. Upon seeing it, Jin almost roared.
What the black knight pulled out was a handful of red hair.
However, instead of doing so, Jin decided to regain his composure and sparked a lump of blue flame in his palm.
"I told you not to play tricks. If it was the head and not just the hair, I might have believed you a bit more."
As soon as the flame dropped onto the black knight's back like a droplet of water, blue fire erupted all over his body in an instant. A shriek followed.
[Agh...! If you keep trying to find Hister's corpse, you too... will die... on this land...]
The black knight didn't finish his sentence and turned into ashes.
Jin, leaving him behind, turned his gaze towards the inside of the cave.
Hoping desperately that Valeria was still alive.
